params.style_prompt: Convert to pixel art, flat colors, clean crisp pixels, limited palette

card.architecture: FLUX.1-Kontext edit graph with per-step pixel-manifold projection + final PixelQuantize
card.summary: Pixel art via FLUX.1-Kontext: the source conditions a reference-latent edit while the projection clamps the x0 estimate onto a fixed grid+palette every step. Virtual resolution sets the sprite's pixel count.
use_cases: pixel art from a reference via Kontext
card.pick_when: You want Kontext's in-context editing to drive the pixel-art conversion.
